visual_name: Day in the life, part twenty two: the plant gets it (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js bowling alley with lanes, pins, neon wall and score screens, box-built character and a potted plant, video stats / group chat / roommate chat / #wins pages, party hats, horn, balloon and confetti, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 38.7 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: his first video to hit a hundred thousand views, and nobody to tell. The group chat says 'nice' and talks about parking, the roommate says 'of what?', the plant gets it, and the party has an attendance of one. Then YourBrand: a post that hits a milestone lands in #wins with his handle, in front of the whole network. He still tells the plant first.
